common.tagline: Learn at your own pace, with a tutor that explains things until they make sense.

landing.title: Your lessons, a patient tutor and revision that sticks.
landing.body: Built for Mauritian secondary students from Grade 7 to Grade 13, following the national curriculum.
landing.pointLearn: Every subject, unit by unit, with worked examples.
landing.pointChat: A tutor that gives hints for homework instead of answers.
landing.pointRevise: Flashcards that come back just before you forget them.

onboarding.nameBody: A first name or a nickname is fine.
onboarding.gradeBody: We'll show the subjects and units for your grade.
onboarding.subjectsBody: Choose the ones you take at school. You can change these later.
onboarding.subjectsCount: {count, plural, =0 {None selected} one {# subject selected} other {# subjects selected}}
onboarding.languageBody: The app and the tutor can use different languages.

errors.name: Enter a name with 1 to 40 characters.
errors.save: We couldn't save your choices. Try again.

settings.title: Settings
settings.profileBody: Your name and grade shape what you see.
settings.privacyBody: We keep your name, grade, subjects, study progress and chats so the app can help you. You can delete your chats at any time.

privacy.title: Privacy notice
privacy.intro: myKPT is used by students under 18, so we collect as little as possible.
privacy.collect1: Your email, so you can sign in.
privacy.collect2: A first name or nickname, your grade and your subjects.
privacy.collect3: Your progress, notes, flashcards and chats with the tutor.
privacy.not1: No date of birth, phone number, address or school name.
privacy.not2: No advertising trackers. We never sell data.
privacy.ai1: Your messages are sent to our AI provider to write a reply. They are not used to train AI models.
privacy.ai2: Messages are checked for safety. If something looks harmful, the tutor points you to someone who can help.
privacy.control1: Delete any chat from the chat history. Ask a parent, guardian or teacher to contact us to delete your account.

meta.description: AI learning platform for Mauritian secondary students, following the national curriculum.
